description: Unit tests for NetworkChangeNotifierFuchsia, testing network interface changes, IP address changes, and connection types using a fake Fuchsia network interface watcher.

classes.name: FakeWatcher
classes.description: Fake implementation of fuchsia.net.interfaces/Watcher for testing interface events.

classes.name: FakeWatcherAsync
classes.description: Runs FakeWatcher in a separate thread for asynchronous event simulation.

classes.name: ResultReceiver<T>
classes.description: Receives and verifies expected sequence of events or connection types.

classes.name: FakeConnectionTypeObserver
classes.description: Mocks connection type changes for testing.

classes.name: FakeNetworkChangeObserver
classes.description: Mocks network change events for testing.

classes.name: FakeIPAddressObserver
classes.description: Mocks IP address change notifications for testing.

methods.name: CreateNotifier
methods.description: Initializes NetworkChangeNotifier with a fake watcher, optionally requiring WLAN and disconnecting watcher.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, flushing watcher thread and processing pending events.
